name: Flirtual
about: Flirtual, a dating site for people who meet in virtual reality

quotes: Terms of Service, last updated December 4, 2025: nothing about bots, automation, scripts, scraping or AI.
Terms: "use this service in order to damage Flirtual or the Service" is listed as not allowed.
Guidelines: "Misusing Flirtual or attempts to maliciously exploit Flirtual will be investigated."
terms.note: The terms say nothing about bots or AI; the guidelines say misuse will be investigated. The Wingman works at a person's pace, from the person's own logged-in browser, and never sends a message the person did not choose.

options.queue: Which queue to read: "love" for dating (the default) or "friend" for Flirtual's Homie Mode. The setting kind chooses it too.
